title: The transported abelian unit lifts to a module map
statement: Let $U,V$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:U\to V$ a morphism, and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $V_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $L$ be the inverse image on sheaves of sets, $a_S:L\dashv R$ its adjunction, $L_a$ the abelian inverse image and $a:L_a\dashv R_a$ its fixed adjunction, and $R_r$ the sectionwise direct image on ring sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. Write $F_{r,T}$ and $F_{a,T}$ for the forgetful functors to set sheaves on $T=U,V$. Fix a ring inverse-image functor $L_r$, an adjunction $a_r:L_r\dashv R_r$, and natural isomorphisms $e_r:L_rF_{r,U}\cong F_{r,V}L$ and $e_a:L_aF_{a,U}\cong F_{a,V}L$. Assume the two hom-equivalence equations: for every ring map $h:L_rG\to F$, $F_{r,V}(a_r(h))=a_S(e_{r,G}^{-1}\circ F_{r,U}(h))$, and for every abelian map $h:L_aG\to F$, $F_{a,V}(a(h))=a_S(e_{a,G}^{-1}\circ F_{a,U}(h))$. Sheaves of modules and their forgetful functors to abelian sheaves are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix any functor $L_M:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O)\to\mathrm{Mod}(L_r\mathcal O)$ and natural isomorphism $e:L_MF_U\cong F_VL_a$, and assume for every module $G$ the transported action equation just written out as follows: with $i_G=F_{a,U}(e_G)\circ e_{a,F_VG}$, the actual scalar multiplication morphisms satisfy $L(\mu_G)=i_G\circ\mu_{L_MG}\circ(e_{r,\mathcal O}^{-1}\times i_G^{-1})\circ\lambda$. Let $R_M$ be sectionwise direct image with scalars restricted along the ring unit $\mathcal O\to R_rL_r\mathcal O$. For every $G\in\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ there exists a module morphism $k_G:G\to R_M L_M G$ whose underlying abelian morphism is $a(e_G^{-1})$, the adjunct of $e_G^{-1}:L_aF_VG\to F_UL_MG$. Only this unit lift is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the supplied abelian hom-equivalence equation to e.inv.app G to identify its underlying set adjunct with the adjunct of iG.inv. Apply the supplied ring equation at the identity and Adjunction.homEquiv_id to identify the underlying ring unit with the adjunct of er.inv.app O. No algebraic-structures existence theorem is applied.

Use Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left and homEquiv_naturality_right on the transported-action equation, cancelling iG.hom followed by iG.inv. The two projections of the product adjunct follow from the same naturality lemmas and prodComparison_fst/snd. Evaluation of set sheaves preserves products: lift any pair (r,m) through its invertible product comparison. Evaluate the action and projection equations at this lift and substitute the supplied sectionwise scalar-action formulas. This gives scalar compatibility with scalars restricted along ar.unit.app O.

The abelian adjunct already supplies additivity and naturality. Use PresheafOfModules.homMk with the established scalar compatibility and wrap the map in SheafOfModules.Hom. Its image under the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves is the original adjunct by reflexivity.

theorem etaleInverseImageModuleUnitLinearLift (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (O : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let a := Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrU := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrV := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let aS := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    let Rr := b.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1}
      (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∀ (Lr : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1} ⥤
        Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
      (ar : Lr ⊣ Rr) (er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L),
    let OR := (sheafCompose U.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (Lr.obj O)
    let OV := (sheafCompose V.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj O
    let eta := (sheafCompose V.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map (ar.unit.app O)
    let RM := SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1}
      (J := V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (K := U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (F := b) eta
    let FV := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} OV
    let FU := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} OR
    ∀ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L)
      (LM : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OR)
      (e : LM ⋙ FU ≅ FV ⋙ La),
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (h : Lr.obj G ⟶ F),
        FrV.map (ar.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FrV.obj G) (FrU.obj F) (er.inv.app G ≫ FrU.map h)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
        FaV.map (a.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h)) ∧
      (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV,
        let iG := (FaU.mapIso (e.app G)) ≪≫ ea.app (FV.obj G)
        ∃ (muV : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶ FaV.obj (FV.obj G))
          (muU : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G))) ⟶
            FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G))),
          (∀ (W : V.Etaleᵒᵖ)
              (x : ((FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))).obj.obj W),
            muV.hom.app W x =
              @SMul.smul (OV.obj.obj W) (G.val.obj W) (G.val.obj W).isModule.toSMul
              ((prod.fst : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
                FrV.obj O).hom.app W x : OV.obj.obj W)
              ((prod.snd : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
                FaV.obj (FV.obj G)).hom.app W x : G.val.obj W)) ∧
          (∀ (W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ)
              (x : ((FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G)))).obj.obj W),
            muU.hom.app W x =
              @SMul.smul (OR.obj.obj W) ((LM.obj G).val.obj W)
                ((LM.obj G).val.obj W).isModule.toSMul
              ((prod.fst : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G))) ⟶
                FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)).hom.app W x : OR.obj.obj W)
              ((prod.snd : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G))) ⟶
                FaU.obj (FU.obj (LM.obj G))).hom.app W x : (LM.obj G).val.obj W)) ∧
          L.map muV = prodComparison L (FrV.obj O) (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ≫
            prod.map (er.inv.app O) iG.inv ≫ muU ≫ iG.hom) →
      ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV,
        ∃ k : G ⟶ RM.obj (LM.obj G),
          FV.map k = a.homEquiv (FV.obj G) (FU.obj (LM.obj G)) (e.inv.app G)
